company.name: Trendex - Connect with stars
company.shortDescription: Trendex is a fan engagement platform offering official digital fan passes and athlete-backed rewards.
company.description: Trendex is a fan engagement platform that connects sports and entertainment fans with athletes and celebrities through official digital fan passes. The company partners directly with players and public figures to issue passes that unlock exclusive content, rewards, and experiences provided by the talent. Fans use these passes to access items such as signed memorabilia, meet-and-greets, VIP events, and online interactions. The platform uses technology to manage access, distribution, and personalization of these fan experiences at scale. Trendex focuses on creating a structured way for supporters to obtain limited digital passes and redeem associated benefits across its ecosystem.
